# input your yak code
log.setLevel("info") 
yakit.AutoInitYakit()
target = cli.String("domain", cli.setDefault("baidu.com"))
url := "https://crt.sh/?q=%25."+target

resp,err = http.Get(url,http.header("User-Agent", "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64; rv:105.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/105.0"))
if err != nil {
    yakit.Error("Connect to %v failed: %v", target, err)
}
rspRaw, err = io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
if err != nil {
    yakit.Error("Connect to %v failed: %v", target, err)
}
reg := "(?:[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9\\-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?\\.){0,}"+str.ReplaceAll(target, ".","\\.")
res :=re.FindAll(string(rspRaw), reg)
rres = str.RemoveRepeat(res)
for _,dd = range rres{
    println(dd)
}
yakit.Info("插件执行完成")
log.Info("插件执行完成")
